sections.title: Boss Mechanics
bullets: Enrage: Below 55% HP, the Bandit Leader enters an enraged state, hitting noticeably harder for the rest of the fight.
His spear thrust deals Heavy Damage by default, switching to Mystical Damage whenever it's crackling with electricity.
Lightning Beam: A forward beam of lightning dealing Mystical Damage that gradually rotates to follow the aggro'd player; circling him avoids getting caught in it.
Whirlwind Attack: Four cone-shaped projectiles dealing Quick Damage, dodged by stepping aside once you see the charge-up.

sections.title: Strategy
paragraphs: Watch his spear for the electrified glow: that's your cue that his hits are about to shift from Heavy to Mystical damage. Circling him defeats the Lightning Beam entirely, and the Whirlwind's cone of projectiles can be avoided with a simple sidestep once it winds up.

paragraphs: Rolls 1-2 times per kill:

sections.title: Boss Mechanics
bullets: Enrage: Below 55% HP, the Elf Warden enters an enraged state, hitting noticeably harder for the rest of the fight.
The Elf Warden attacks with a greatsword, dealing Heavy Damage or Mystical Damage while his greatsword is glowing hot.

Fire Beam: The Elf Warden shoots a beam of fire straight out in front of them, dealing Mystical Damage and slowly spinning in the direction of a random player. This attack can be avoided by running in circles around them
Fireballs: Fireballs periodically fall around the Elf Warden, creating multiple small AOEs that deal Mystical Damage
Fire Tornadoes: The Elf Warden summons several magical fire tornadoes, creating multiple small AOEs that move around and deal Mystical Damage
Whirlwind Attack: The Elf Warden launches four projectiles in a cone in front of them, dealing Quick Damage. The attack can be avoided by moving to the side when the charge-up indicator appears
Summon Allies: The Elf Warden can summon 1, 2, or more (depending on the amount of players) Elf and Elf Scholar allies, who appear from the nearby portal

sections.title: Strategy
paragraphs: Run in circles during Fire Beam, avoid the falling Fireball and roaming Fire Tornado AOEs, and sidestep the Whirlwind Attack. Focus down any summoned Elf/Elf Scholar allies quickly to reduce incoming damage.

sections.title: Boss Mechanics
bullets: Enrage: Below 55% HP, the Skeleton Pioneer enters an enraged state, hitting noticeably harder for the rest of the fight.

Weapon & Shield Swapping: He switches between two weapons: the Mace for Heavy Damage and the Sword for Quick Damage. He enters the fight without a shield equipped, but will pick one up mid-fight and swap between a Parry Shield (blocks Quick Damage) and a Wooden Shield (blocks Heavy Damage).
Stomp Attack: A jumping ground slam that deals Heavy Damage across the impact area.
Charge Attack: A straight-line dash dealing sustained Quick Damage, telegraphed only by a brief red glint that leaves little time to react.
Falling Stalactites: Stalactites drop around him periodically, each leaving a small Heavy Damage AOE.

sections.title: Strategy
paragraphs: Keep an eye on which weapon he's holding: the Mace hits for Heavy damage while the Sword hits for Quick, and whichever shield he's carrying blocks the matching type. His Charge Attack gives only a quick red glint as warning, and stalactites will keep falling around him throughout the fight, so don't stand still for long.

sections.title: Boss Mechanics
bullets: Enrage: Below 66.6% HP, The Burning King enters an enraged state, hitting noticeably harder for the rest of the fight.
His basic swing cycles through three damage types signaled by swipe color: green for Quick, red for Heavy, and blue for Mystical.
Charge Attack: A straight-line dash delivering ongoing Quick Damage to anything in its path.
Stomp Attack: A leaping ground slam that deals Heavy Damage in an area around his landing point.

Summon Minion: He retreats to a safe platform and calls in two or more Ashen Warriors, Mages, or Archers (scaling with player count), harassing the group with ranged attacks from a distance until his minions are dealt with.
Fireball: A homing fireball that tracks the targeted player until it connects, dealing Mystical Damage.
Fire Split: A fireball that bursts outward in every direction dealing Mystical Damage, while additional fireballs rain down at random during the same window.
Throw Cannonball: A thrown cannonball dealing Heavy Damage on impact.
Throw Stone Spike: A thrown stone spike dealing Quick Damage on impact.

sections.title: Strategy
paragraphs: His swipe color calls out the incoming damage type before it lands: green for Quick, red for Heavy, and blue for Mystical. Read the color, not just the swing. A brief red glint gives away his Charge Attack. When he retreats to summon Ashen minions, prioritize clearing them quickly, since he stays at range peppering you until they're dead.
